root_cause: Arrow key navigation in Pikaday adds/subtracts a fixed number of days (1 or 7) without skipping disabled dates (weekends, min/max bounds, or custom disableDayFn), allowing navigation to non-bookable days.
repair_strategy: Replace the _onKeyChange handler with logic that steps by the requested amount then repeatedly advances in the same direction while the resulting date is disabled or out of bounds, leaving the date unchanged if the step would exceed the allowed range.
expected_accessibility_effect: ArrowRight will now move to the next enabled weekday, preventing focus on disabled weekend days and ensuring keyboard navigation respects the booking window.
functional_risks: Performance impact if many consecutive disabled dates exist (unlikely in typical use).
Custom disableDayFn must be compatible with the new skipping logic.
If all dates in the range are disabled, arrow keys will leave the date unchanged (no movement).
Ensure shiftDate does not cause infinite loops when stepping beyond bounds.
verification_requirements: Pressing ArrowRight from Friday 2026-11-20 results in Monday 2026-11-23.
Pressing ArrowLeft from Monday 2026-11-23 results in Friday 2026-11-20.
Pressing ArrowDown then ArrowRight from any date within the range results in the last bookable day 2026-11-27.
Arrow keys do not change the date when at the minimum or maximum enabled date.
Existing key bindings (Enter, Escape, Backspace, Delete) continue to work as before.
